dossier.headline: Nvidia's first results without Jensen Huang
dossier.summary: Nvidia reports third-quarter results on Tuesday 17 November at about 4:20 pm ET, its first report since Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO, with CFO Colette Kress presenting as interim CEO. The stock fell about 13% last week and slid again on Monday, dragging the Nasdaq lower; third-quarter sales are expected around $109 billion.
why_it_matters: The results are a key read for AI and chip stocks worldwide
They land before India's Wednesday open, so Indian IT and chip-linked names take the read-through
